answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: each agent locks 50 POA and a hashed log of past actions, sealed by a cipher only its history opens. New identities start thin, like a willow shoot, capped low; limits rise as behavior accrues over 20 epochs. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 fake histories and 50,000 POA locked. One honest agent pays once, keeps its full reward. No two sable pelts match, nor do honest histories: fakes cluster, get flagged, forfeit deposits.
